name: Koa Health Mindset
one_liner: Koa Health app that teaches CBT techniques to people with depression, used alongside in-person treatment through a clinic or organization.
best_for: Adults in treatment for depression whose clinician or organization offers Koa Mindset
People who want to practise CBT skills between appointments
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People without access through a provider or organization (no individual sign-up)
Anyone looking for a replacement for treatment; it is meant to add to in-person care
short_description: CBT-based app for people living with depression, built by Koa Health with Massachusetts General Hospital and offered through providers and organizations.
long_description: Koa Mindset is a self-directed app from Koa Health for people with depression. It teaches cognitive behavioral therapy techniques and is meant to complement in-person treatment; Koa says it was developed with Massachusetts General Hospital and includes in-app messaging. Koa describes Mindset as a wellness device that has not been reviewed or cleared by the FDA. It is sold to providers and organizations, and Koa does not list a price or a way for individuals to sign up. No published study of Koa Mindset was found.

pricing.starting_price: Free through your provider or organization
pricing.notes: Koa does not publish a price; organizations book a consultation or demo.

privacy.notes: Koa's privacy policy could not be opened for this review; the App Store label lists health, contact and usage data linked to you and declares no tracking.

primary_uses: Practising skills between therapy or doctor visits

patient_summary: If your clinic or organization offers Koa Mindset, you use the app between appointments to learn and practise CBT skills for depression. It is not sold to individuals and is meant to add to your treatment, not replace it.

availability.note: Only through providers or organizations that contract with Koa Health.
